bundle.longDescription: Mailchat Vault — local archive and full-text search over your own email and chat history. Imports mbox, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal and Discord exports; syncs mail read-only over IMAP. Search runs locally; optional AI-assisted search sends the query and matching rows to your chosen provider after explicit consent. The app does not encrypt the archive or backups.
